title: Spotify playlist dialog offers Try again where retry cannot help
acceptance: Identify each unretryable playlist error and its actionable recovery.
After approved implementation, verify retryable errors retain retry and unretryable errors offer the appropriate recovery.
nextAction: Owner asked to start RF-74 in the Air session on 2026-11-13 (next in the web plan; closes RF-92); the session closed after read-only orientation, so claim it on a branch and draft PR first. Mapping so far in apps/web/src/components/TrackSearch.tsx on main b22ec04c: the saved-playlist drill-in already has no retry for forbidden, quota and reauth (classifyPlaylistDrillInError), and paste-a-link offers Manage connections for NOT_CONNECTED/REAUTH_REQUIRED. Two gaps found: the saved-playlists index shows Try again on a 429 PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXCEEDED (only reauth is split out before the retry branch), and catalog search shows Try again on the same quota error. Still to review: paste-a-link forbidden/quota copy and any other unretryable code. Then propose the mapping, implement with TrackSearch tests, and close RF-92 with it.
